nodes.title: Atlas — Factory Acceptance Test Plan
nodes.rationale: Factory acceptance test plan for Atlas. Test parameters (full-load run, insulation testing) depend on motor rating but snippet does not show literal '22 kW'. Requires review to ensure test specifications align with 18.5 kW.

surfaceProps.impactStatement: The Factory Acceptance Test Plan defines test parameters including full-load run and insulation testing. These test specifications must be verified against the 18.5 kW rating to ensure test procedures, acceptance criteria, and test facility capabilities remain appropriate.
surfaceProps.suggestedAssignee: test engineer or Atlas project engineer

nodes.title: Atlas — Cable Schedule and Sizing Calculations
nodes.rationale: Cable schedule and sizing calculations for Atlas. Conductor sizing depends on motor power rating but no literal '22 kW' visible in snippet. Calculations must be verified against 18.5 kW to ensure cable sizing remains adequate.

surfaceProps.impactStatement: Cable sizing calculations are based on motor power rating. The reduction from 22 kW to 18.5 kW affects current draw and therefore conductor sizing, protection device ratings, and voltage drop calculations. All cable specifications must be recalculated to verify they remain adequate and compliant.

nodes.title: TASK-007: Schedule Atlas factory acceptance test

surfaceProps.impactStatement: Factory acceptance test scheduling depends on equipment specification. The test facility must be capable of testing 18.5 kW equipment, and the test schedule may need adjustment if different test equipment or procedures are required for the revised rating.
surfaceProps.suggestedAssignee: Atlas project coordinator or test scheduling lead
